seo.title: Fatanira Natwe — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Shyigikira Isôoko binyuze mu guha, ubukorerabushake, cyangwa ubufatanye.

donate.title: Tanga Inkunga
donate.desc: Inkunga yawe y'amafaranga idufasha gukoresha porogaramu z'urubyiruko, imishinga yo guteza imbere abakobwa, ibikorwa bya siporo, no gukomeza ikigo cyacu cy'abaturage.

volunteer.title: Ubufatanye
volunteer.desc: Sangira ubumenyi bwawe — kuva mu kwigisha ikoranabuhanga kugera mu guhugura siporo — kandi utange itandukaniro i Masoro.

partner.title: Fatanira Natwe
partner.desc: Ibigo n'amashyirahamwe bishobora gufatanya na Isôoko gutera inkunga porogaramu zihariye, gufasha mu birori, cyangwa gushyigikira ibikorwa remezo.
